name: Mattithiah
overview: Mattithiah was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified as the firstborn of Shallum. His role or activities beyond this designation are not detailed in the biblical record. This brief mention situates him within the Levitical lineage, a tribe set apart for priestly duties in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Mattithiah means 'gift of YHWH,' reflecting a recognition of God's providence. It is a proper name recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:31 without indication that it was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Mattithiah as the son and firstborn of Shallum, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections are documented beyond this explicit relationship in 1 Chronicles 9:31.
scriptureSignificance: Mattithiah's significance lies primarily in his identification as the firstborn son of Shallum within the Levitical line, which underscores the continuity of priestly heritage in Israel. Though the biblical text offers limited information, his mention affirms the genealogical records that preserve the heritage of those who served in sacred duties. This contributes to the broader biblical narrative emphasizing God's provision and order in the priesthood.
